Stop! Taurus, the stars are screaming at you right now.
Mars is squaring your ruling Venus in the 7th House, igniting fierce debates and heightened romance that could either forge deep bonds or spark sharp conflicts.
Saturn is forming a solid trine to your 10th House, reinforcing structure and long‑term career growth.
If you are single, as an Earth sign the Venus‑Mars clash will attract a magnetic, adventurous partner who craves sensual pleasure; if you are taken, watch for impulsive outbursts that could damage trust and create lingering doubts.
Your 2nd House of values is energized by a subtle Neptune sextile, urging you to trust your intuition on finances while steering clear of fleeting, wasteful spending.
A surprise freelance gig appears as an unexpected blessing, turning a routine day into a pleasant monetary windfall.
Follow for tomorrow's reading and stay ahead of the cosmic currents.
